description: This file declares the AVOutputTV class which extends AVOutputBase and provides a comprehensive interface for managing TV output settings such as picture modes, HDR formats, resolution, HDR modes, and other display configuration parameters. It includes multiple JSON RPC methods for getting and setting display properties, capabilities, and handling TV-related events within a plugin architecture.

classes.name: AVOutputTV
